claims.claim: US published final tariff schedule with 25-100% rates on Chinese industrial and tech goods.
claims.uncertainty: Exemption process may narrow effective scope.
claims.risk_if_wrong: Supply chain restructuring based on incomplete tariff picture.

claims.claim: Trade re-routing through ASEAN is already observable.
claims.uncertainty: Some re-routing may be transshipment relabeling rather than genuine value-add.
claims.risk_if_wrong: Compliance exposure if origin rules tighten.

claims.claim: China's retaliation will target US agricultural exports.
claims.uncertainty: Retaliation scope depends on bilateral negotiation dynamics.
claims.risk_if_wrong: Commodity hedging based on assumed retaliation that may not materialize.

evidence.name: UN Comtrade bilateral trade data
supports: Trade flow shifts between China, ASEAN, US
